```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 17_correlation_partial
title: What's the partial correlation between coffee and test score for our seven students, accounting for sleep?
questions:
  - id: partial_r_toy
    type: numeric
    prompt: >
      For the seven students, $r_{XY} = -.50$, $r_{XZ} = -.667$, and
      $r_{YZ} = .667$.
    answer: -0.10
    tolerance: 0.015
    min: -1
    max: 1
    explanation: >
      $r_{XY \cdot Z} = \dfrac{-.50 - (-.667)(.667)}{\sqrt{(1 - .667^2)(1 - .667^2)}} = \dfrac{-.50 + .444}{.556} = -.10$.
      Most of the correlation between coffee and test score goes away once
      sleep is accounted for, but not all of it.
```
